# MyCoffeeLab, full notes for agents

Publisher: Atharva Mahamuni. He publishes the house defaults. He is not presented as a barista.

Picture model picture-model@1:
- Espresso and water: 1.00 g/ml in the interface, because the scale is the instrument.
- Whole milk: 1.03 g/ml.
- Steamed volume = liquid milk volume × aeration.
- Foam centimetres = foam millilitres / the vessel rim area.
- Chocolate sauce: 1.20 g/ml.
- A recipe that draws past the cup is a failed build.
- Crema is drawn only on an unmixed shot and is not part of the yield mass.
- Cold brew in the tumbler is one mixed body: 150 g concentrate + 150 g water.

SCA golden cup, as printed on the ratio page: 55 g coffee per 1 L water, ± 10%. Center ratio 1:18.2. Band about 1:16.7 to 1:20.

Locked examples:
- 500 g water at the SCA center → 27.5 g coffee, bloom 55.0 g.
- 500 g water at 1:16 → 31.3 g coffee, bloom 62.5 g.
- 100 g coffee, 500 g cold-brew water, retention 2 → 300 g concentrate. A 1:1 dilution adds 300 g water to that concentrate.

Pages are static HTML. Sliders update a polite live region in the browser and do not send the recipe anywhere.

Canonical origin until a domain is chosen: https://mycoffeelab.example
